_description: Response body returned by GET /api/reviews, GET /api/reviews/{id}, GET /api/reviews/labelled, GET /api/reviews/unlabelled, PATCH /api/reviews/{id}/label, and POST /api/reviews/{id}/feedback.

_notes.label: Null if the review has not yet been classified.
_notes.labelSource: Null if the review has not yet been classified. SEED = model-confident auto-label, MANUAL = human operator, CLAUDE = Claude AI oracle.
_notes.createdAt: System-managed. Set on insert. Never changes.

_variant_labelled_by_claude._comment: A review that was uncertain and labelled by the Claude AI oracle.
_variant_labelled_by_claude.reviewText: An absolute masterpiece. The performances were outstanding and the storyline kept me gripped.
_variant_labelled_by_claude.label: POSITIVE

_variant_labelled_manually._comment: A review that was corrected by a human operator via the feedback endpoint.
_variant_labelled_manually.reviewText: Oh sure, absolutely riveting if you enjoy watching paint dry for two hours.
_variant_labelled_manually.label: NEGATIVE

_variant_labelled_by_seed._comment: A review that the model classified confidently — no oracle consultation needed.
_variant_labelled_by_seed.reviewText: Dreadful from beginning to end. I cannot believe this film received any praise whatsoever.
_variant_labelled_by_seed.label: NEGATIVE

_variant_unlabelled._comment: A review that has been submitted but not yet classified (model not trained yet).
_variant_unlabelled.reviewText: An interesting but deeply flawed attempt at social commentary.
